problem: Points readers at get_performance_metrics as if it were always available, but admin tools are registered only when PYEYE_ENABLE_PERFORMANCE_METRICS is set (src/pyeye/mcp/server.py ADMIN_TOOLS registration), and that variable is off by default. A reader following this page won't find the tool.
replacement: The server's in-process performance metrics are available through the opt-in `get_performance_metrics` admin tool, registered only when `PYEYE_ENABLE_PERFORMANCE_METRICS` is set (default: bind env.PYEYE_ENABLE_PERFORMANCE_METRICS.default in a fact block); see the [tool reference](reference/tools.md).
